description: Make the translated draft of a post (a draft or one already sent) in a linked project that publishes in another language. The app adapts the copy, the first comment, the per-network copies, the thread and the TEXT variables of a design (hashtags in the new language; links, mentions, numbers and names kept): do not translate yourself. A design keeps its picture and the answer carries needs_png=true with render {html, css, format}: render it, store the PNG with viralhunt_update_post {id, png}, then approve if wanted. A plain picture (no template) stays unless `image` hands the translated one. The same translation twice is refused. The texts come back without em dashes, and for every network of the target project whose limit the translated body passes (X 280, Bluesky 300, Threads 500) a short copy is written as that network's override: `shortened` lists them (network, limit, full length, short length) and `overrides` carries the copies. One brand, two languages: link the projects once (Projects → Also publish translated in…), work in one project, and the other language comes out of this call or of `translations` on viralhunt_approve_draft. Never write the second language by hand.

account_ids.description: Accounts of the target project (default: all postable).

image.description: https URL of the translated picture, for a post whose picture is not a template.

lang.description: Override the target language (es, en, pt, fr, de, it…).

project_id.description: The target project (from translates_to on viralhunt_targets).

send_mode.description: draft (default) waits in the target project; send (owner/admin) goes out at once when there is nothing to render.

name: viralhunt_translate_post
